summary: Completed comprehensive testing of NairaTrack Nigerian Tax & Expense Management App. Backend API testing achieved 95.2% success rate (20/21 tests passed). Frontend testing successfully validated all core features including landing page, user registration, admin login, dashboard functionality, tax calculations, transaction management, settings, and Pidgin language toggle.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns authentication error when accessed without proper session cookies

design_issues.issue: Pidgin mode successfully implemented and working

passed_tests: Landing page loads with NairaTrack branding and CTA buttons
User registration with business type selection (Freelancer, SME, Company)
Admin login with valid credentials (admin@nairatrack.ng)
Dashboard displays tax health score (15/100), income/expenses (₦0), bank balance (₦287,172)
Tax calculation shows CITA for company business type
Transaction management page loads with summary cards
Settings page shows user profile, subscription plans (Starter ₦2k, Growth ₦4k, Business ₦6k)
Bank account linking available for Business plan users
Pidgin/English language toggle working correctly
Navigation between all major pages (Dashboard, Transactions, Tax Calculator, Settings)
API health checks and authentication flows
Transaction creation and retrieval
Bank account management (mock Nigerian banks)
AI chat assistant with Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration
Tax filing guide and checklist
Education articles (4 articles available)
User settings and subscription management
Proper Nigerian tax calculations (PITA, CITA, VAT 7.5%)
Receipt upload functionality
Reports and export features
